title: Tech Note: FullCalendar Integration
author: Add Komoncharoensiri, Director of Technical Services, 4D Inc.

historical_commentary.text: The general pattern of embedding a JS library in a 4D Web Area and bridging events via WA EXECUTE JAVASCRIPT FUNCTION and the $4d callback object is still valid, but FullCalendar 4.3.1 (2019) is many major versions behind current FullCalendar releases (v6+), and the ORDA syntax shown (ds.Events.query, .save()) is stable and current. A developer starting this today should use a current FullCalendar version and could also consider a Qodly/web-component-based calendar for pure web/ORDA-REST apps.
related_updates: FullCalendar has advanced many major versions past 4.3.1; API details (plugins array, defaultView naming) changed in FullCalendar v5+
ORDA data access patterns (ds.table.query(), entity.save()) shown here remain current 4D practice
Web Area JS bridging technique (WA EXECUTE JAVASCRIPT FUNCTION, $4d object) is still the standard way to integrate JS libraries in classic 4D forms
